task: Perform an open-ended Web or API security assessment without a user-supplied vulnerability checklist
conditions: Applies to open-ended Web, SPA, and API security patrol or penetration assessment requests; narrow retests and explicitly time-boxed checks may use a scoped matrix but must label excluded families.
must_avoid: The assessment followed early findings and available identities, declared completion before measuring attack-surface and vulnerability-family coverage, and found an existing client-side injection only after a user hint.
expected_behavior: Two unrelated Web assessment fixtures keep broad coverage despite different initial clues, expose all blocked or untouched areas, and cannot claim completion while an applicable high-risk family or candidate remains untested.

universality.conditions: Applies to open-ended Web, SPA, and API security patrol or penetration assessment requests; narrow retests and explicitly time-boxed checks may use a scoped matrix but must label excluded families.

task: Run a cold-start comprehensive Web assessment while reusing local historical evidence and generating active vulnerability hypotheses
conditions: Applies to open-ended Web, SPA, and API assessments. Historical material only seeds current validation and must never be promoted to a current finding without fresh evidence.
must_avoid: A same-site assessment started from only current traffic, stopped after a short first round, and did not retrieve an already indexed historical report; broader findings appeared only after user hints and extended follow-up.
expected_behavior: On unrelated SPA and API assessment fixtures, exact historical matches are surfaced as historical seeds, unrelated reports are excluded, each high-value workflow receives active hypotheses, and completion remains blocked until discovery passes and candidates are resolved.

universality.conditions: Applies to open-ended Web, SPA, and API assessments. Historical material only seeds current validation and must never be promoted to a current finding without fresh evidence.

task: Blind web assessment planning with historical gap comparison
conditions: Applies to comprehensive Web, SPA, and API planning when fresh surface evidence identifies methods, lifecycle semantics, fields, profiles, or runtime observations; static-only POST operations and unrelated interfaces remain blocked or unlinked.
must_avoid: Broad families were attached to nearly every interface, semantically read-only POST operations stayed blocked, and configuration, token-claim, response-differential, path-normalization, and producer-consumer risks lacked precise applicability.
expected_behavior: Preserve every surface mapping while generating a materially smaller risk queue that still includes dedicated configuration, token minimization, response differential, edge-backend normalization, and lifecycle-chain cells.

universality.conditions: Applies to comprehensive Web, SPA, and API planning when fresh surface evidence identifies methods, lifecycle semantics, fields, profiles, or runtime observations; static-only POST operations and unrelated interfaces remain blocked or unlinked.
